SELECT pp.*,mp.product_name as materialName,mp.cell as cell FROM product_pick AS pp left join md_product_packaging mp on pp.material = mp.product_no and mp.delete_flag = 0 where pp.delete_flag = 0 and pp.sudn_id = #{sudnId} and pp.status = #{status}
AND pp.delivery like concat('%', #{delivery}, '%')
AND mp.cell like concat('%', #{cell}, '%')
AND pp.item like concat('%', #{item}, '%')
AND pp.sscc like concat('%', #{ssccNb}, '%')
AND pp.material like concat('%', #{material}, '%')
AND pp.batch like concat('%', #{batch}, '%')
AND pp.production_batch like concat('%', #{productionBatch}, '%')
AND pp.shipper like concat('%', #{shipper}, '%')
and DATE(pp.create_time) >= DATE(#{startCreateTime}) and DATE(pp.create_time) <= DATE(#{endCreateTime})

select pp.delivery as delivery, pp.plant as plant, -- pp.sscc as ssccNumber, pp.ship_to_party as shipToParty, pp.name_of_ship_to_party as nameOfShipToParty, pp.delivery_date as deliveryDate, pp.item as item, pp.material as material, STR_TO_DATE(pp.expire_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as batch, pp.production_batch as production_batch, pp.sales_unit as salesUnit, sum(delivery_quantity) as deliveryQuantity from product_pick pp where pp.delete_flag = 0 and pp.status != -1 and pp.sudn_id = #{sudnId} and pp.status = #{status}
AND pp.delivery like concat('%', #{delivery}, '%')
AND pp.material like concat('%', #{material}, '%')
AND pp.batch like concat('%', #{batch}, '%')
AND pp.production_batch like concat('%', #{productionBatch}, '%')
AND pp.shipper like concat('%', #{shipper}, '%')
and DATE(pp.create_time) >= DATE(#{startCreateTime}) and DATE(pp.create_time) <= DATE(#{endCreateTime})
group by pp.delivery, pp.plant, pp.ship_to_party, pp.name_of_ship_to_party, pp.delivery_date, pp.item, pp.material, pp.expire_date, pp.production_batch, pp.sales_unit,pp.batch

SELECT ps.from_prod_order fromProdOrder, ps.ware_code wareCode, ps.area_code areaCode, ps.sscc_number ssccNumber, ps.material_nb materialNb, mpp.product_name materialName, mpp.type as materialType , ps.total_stock totalStock, (SELECT SUM(p.total_stock) FROM product_stock p WHERE p.from_prod_order = ps.from_prod_order and p.delete_flag = 0 and p.plant_nb = '7761') totalStockSum, ps.freeze_stock freezeStock, ps.available_stock availableStock, mpp.box_specification boxSpecification, ROUND(ps.total_stock * mpp.box_specification) as pcsTotalStock, ROUND(ps.freeze_stock * mpp.box_specification) as pcsFreezeStock, ROUND(ps.available_stock * mpp.box_specification) as pcsAvailableStock, ps.quality_status qualityStatus, ps.unit, mpp.cell, pp.name_of_ship_to_party nameOfShipToParty, pp.plant, pp.delivery, pp.ship_to_party shipToParty, pp.delivery_date deliveryDate, pp.item, pp.batch, pp.delivery_quantity deliveryQuantity, sp.uom, sp.storage_location storageLocation, pp.production_batch productionBatch, pp.bin_down_date binDownDate, sp.delivery_nb deliveryNb from product_pick pp left join product_stock ps on ps.sscc_number=pp.sscc and ps.plant_nb = '7761' -- and ps.delete_flag = 0 left join spdn sp on sp.sscc_number=pp.sscc and sp.delete_flag =0 left join md_product_packaging mpp on mpp.product_no = ps.material_nb and mpp.delete_flag = 0 WHERE pp.delete_flag=0 and pp.`status`>=0 and pp.update_time >= #{startDate} and pp.update_time <= #{endDate}
